mapper.sql: daily_quest_id, user_id, quest_date, status, total_count, correct_count, score, reward_policy_id, point_transaction_id, completed_at
daily_quest_item_id, daily_quest_id, question_id, display_order, question_snapshot_json, user_answer_json, is_correct, answered_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM daily_quests WHERE daily_quest_id = #{dailyQuestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM daily_quest_items WHERE daily_quest_id = #{dailyQuestId} ORDER BY display_order

WITH answer_history AS ( SELECT question.question_key, FIRST_VALUE(question.main_chapter_id) OVER ( PARTITION BY question.question_key ORDER BY answer.answered_at DESC, answer.quiz_answer_id DESC ) AS main_chapter_id, FIRST_VALUE(question.sub_chapter_id) OVER ( PARTITION BY question.question_key ORDER BY answer.answered_at DESC, answer.quiz_answer_id DESC ) AS sub_chapter_id, FIRST_VALUE(question.usage_type) OVER ( PARTITION BY question.question_key ORDER BY answer.answered_at DESC, answer.quiz_answer_id DESC ) AS usage_type, answer.is_correct, answer.answered_at, SUM(CASE WHEN answer.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER ( PARTITION BY question.question_key ORDER BY answer.answered_at DESC, answer.quiz_answer_id DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS later_correct_count FROM quiz_answers answer INNER JOIN quiz_attempts attempt ON attempt.attempt_id = answer.attempt_id INNER JOIN quiz_questions question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id WHERE attempt.user_id = #{userId} AND answer.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND question.usage_type IN ( 'LEVEL_TEST', 'SUB_CHAPTER', 'MAIN_CHAPTER' ) ) SELECT latest.question_key, latest.main_chapter_id, latest.sub_chapter_id, MAX(latest.answered_at) AS answered_at, COUNT(*) AS wrong_count FROM answer_history latest WHERE latest.is_correct = FALSE AND latest.later_correct_count = 0 AND NOT ( latest.usage_type = 'LEVEL_TEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.main_chapter_id = latest.main_chapter_id AND curriculum.completed_at IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY latest.question_key, latest.main_chapter_id, latest.sub_chapter_id, latest.usage_type ORDER BY answered_at DESC, latest.question_key

SELECT DISTINCT question.question_key FROM daily_quests quest INNER JOIN daily_quest_items item ON item.daily_quest_id = quest.daily_quest_id INNER JOIN quiz_questions question ON question.question_id = item.question_id WHERE quest.user_id = #{userId} AND quest.quest_date >= #{fromDate} AND quest.quest_date < #{questDate} AND question.usage_type = 'DAILY_GENERAL' ORDER BY question.question_key

SELECT item.daily_quest_item_id, item.daily_quest_id, item.question_id, item.display_order, item.question_snapshot_json, item.user_answer_json, item.is_correct, item.answered_at, item.created_at FROM daily_quest_items item INNER JOIN daily_quests quest ON quest.daily_quest_id = item.daily_quest_id WHERE item.daily_quest_item_id = #{dailyQuestItemId} AND quest.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_quest_items WHERE daily_quest_id = #{dailyQuestId} AND user_answer_json IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_quests ( user_id, quest_date, status, total_count, correct_count, score, reward_policy_id, point_transaction_id, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{questDate}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{correctCount}, #{score}, #{rewardPolicyId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{pointTransactionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )

INSERT INTO daily_quest_items ( daily_quest_id, question_id, display_order, question_snapshot_json, user_answer_json, is_correct, answered_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{dailyQuestId}, #{questionId}, #{displayOrder}, #{questionSnapshotJson}, #{userAnswerJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{correct,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{answeredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt} )
